name: ABot-World
description: ABot-World is a real-time interactive world simulator developed by Alibaba AMAP CV Lab. Built around a 5-billion parameter causal video world model (ABot-World-0-5B-LF) fine-tuned from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, it enables open-ended, action-conditioned video generation running in real time at 720p resolution @ 16 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU.
keyFeatures: Infinite Interactive Rollout via LongForcing student-teacher distillation (over 1 hour continuous rollout without scene lock-in or drift)
High-Performance Consumer Hardware Execution (720p@16FPS, ~1.2s latency, ~19GB VRAM on RTX 5090)
5B Parameter Causal Architecture fine-tuned from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B
Real-time Closed-Loop Action Control (keyboard control for camera, roaming, and interactions)
Unified Video & 3DGS Synthesis (combines video generation with 3D Gaussian Splatting for explorable 3D scenes)
curatorNotes: Verified paper arXiv:2607.19191 and open-source project from Alibaba AMAP CV Lab.
